name: FaceGest
description: Facial gestures offer a natural and hands-free interaction modality for human–computer interaction (HCI), yet existing facial analysis benchmarks largely concentrate on emotion recognition from static imagery or short clips, limiting their applicability to interaction-centric systems. Moreover, the lack of large-scale video-based datasets hinders the development and evaluation of models capable of understanding fine-grained, dynamic facial gestures in real-world environments.
